extra_vocab.en: a word you say when you leave
extra_vocab.note: 多益常出現在電話、會議結束或辦公室對話裡，是比較口語、輕鬆的道別。正式的商務信件結尾通常不用 bye。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: bye 是口語道別語，書信或正式場合改用 Best regards 或 Sincerely 等結尾語。

example.en: Please say bye to the clients before they leave the building.
example.zh: 請在客戶離開大樓前向他們道別。

example.en: Let's finish here. Bye for now, and talk to you next week.
example.zh: 今天先到這裡。先這樣，下週再聊。

example.en: The receptionist said bye-bye to the guests and closed the door.
example.zh: 櫃台人員向訪客說掰掰後把門關上。

examples.en: Thank you for calling. Bye, and have a nice day.
examples.zh: 謝謝您來電。再見，祝您有美好的一天。

examples.en: I have another meeting, so I have to say bye now.
examples.zh: 我還有另一場會議，所以現在得先道別了。

examples.en: She waved and said bye to her coworkers at the door.
examples.zh: 她在門口揮手，向同事們說再見。

confusable.diff: 發音和 bye 完全相同，但 buy 是動詞，意思是「買」。
confusable.usage: bye 是感嘆詞（道別），buy 是動詞（買東西），只有發音一樣，詞性與意思完全不同。

example.en: We need to buy new printer paper before the end of the week.
example.zh: 我們需要在本週結束前買新的影印紙。

confusable.diff: 發音相同，by 是介系詞，表示「在…之前」或「藉由」。
confusable.usage: by 後面接時間或方法，bye 單獨使用，不接其他字。

example.en: Please send the report by five o'clock today.
example.zh: 請在今天五點前寄出報告。

similar.diff: 意思相同但比 bye 稍正式，客服與接待場合常用。

example.en: Goodbye, Mr. Lee. Thank you for visiting our office today.
example.zh: 李先生再見，謝謝您今天來我們辦公室。

similar.diff: 比 bye 多了「待會見」的語氣，通常表示很快會再見面。

example.en: I have to go now, so see you later at the meeting.
example.zh: 我現在得走了，會議上見。

example.en: The manager said goodbye to the team and left early.
example.zh: 經理向團隊道別後提早離開了。

example.en: Hello, this is Anna from the sales department.
example.zh: 你好，我是業務部的安娜。

extra_vocab.en: a man who works in business, often as an owner or manager
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於人物介紹、新聞報導與廣告，指做生意或在公司擔任重要角色的人。現在也常用比較不分性別的 businessperson。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 指女性用 businesswoman，不分性別可用 businessperson。

example.en: Many businessmen attended the trade show held in Taipei last week.
example.zh: 許多商人參加了上週在台北舉辦的貿易展。

example.en: He became a successful businessman after he started his own company.
example.zh: 他創立自己的公司後成為一位成功的商人。

example.en: A local businessman donated money to the new community school.
example.zh: 一位當地商人捐款給新的社區學校。

example.en: The retired businessman now teaches a class on small business.
example.zh: 這位退休的商人現在開設小型企業的課程。

examples.en: The company was started by a young businessman in 2010.
examples.zh: 這家公司是由一位年輕商人在 2010 年創立的。

examples.en: A well-known businessman will speak at our conference next month.
examples.zh: 一位知名商人下個月會在我們的研討會上演講。

examples.en: Please introduce yourself to the businessman waiting in the lobby.
examples.zh: 請向在大廳等候的那位商人自我介紹。

confusable.diff: business 是「生意、公司」，businessman 是做生意的「人」。

example.en: Our business grew quickly after we opened the second store.
example.zh: 我們開了第二家店後，生意成長得很快。

similar.diff: 意思相同，但不分性別，較中性，現代商務文章更常見。

example.en: The businessperson signed the contract and shook hands with us.
example.zh: 這位商人簽了合約並和我們握手。

similar.diff: owner 強調「擁有」公司或店面；businessman 只說明這個人從事商業。

example.en: The company owner will join our meeting this afternoon.
example.zh: 公司老闆今天下午會參加我們的會議。

example.en: The executive approved the new budget this morning.
example.zh: 這位主管今天早上核准了新預算。

example.en: Our manager will explain the new rules at noon.
example.zh: 我們的經理中午會說明新規定。

example.en: The owner of the shop is out of town today.
example.zh: 這家店的老闆今天出城了。

derived.link: business + woman，做生意的女性，和 businessman 成對，像 chairman、chairwoman
business + person，不分性別的說法，像 salesperson

extra_vocab.en: a person who buys and sells things for other people
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於保險、房地產、股票與貨運等仲介情境。當動詞時，broker a deal 表示居中促成交易或協議。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: broker 當動詞時是及物動詞，直接接 a deal 或 an agreement，不加介系詞。

example.en: Several brokers attended the meeting about the new housing law.
example.zh: 幾位仲介參加了關於新住宅法的會議。

example.en: She brokers deals between small farms and local supermarkets.
example.zh: 她居中促成小農場和當地超市之間的交易。

example.en: Our manager brokered the contract between the two firms.
example.zh: 我們的經理居中促成了兩家公司之間的合約。

example.en: He is brokering a deal between the factory and the shop.
example.zh: 他正在促成工廠與商店之間的交易。

example.en: An insurance broker can compare prices from several companies for you.
example.zh: 保險經紀人可以幫你比較好幾家公司的價格。

example.en: The real estate broker charges a fee of two percent.
example.zh: 這位房地產經紀人收取百分之二的費用。

example.en: Our lawyer helped broker a deal with the supplier.
example.zh: 我們的律師幫忙和供應商談成了一筆交易。

examples.en: Our broker showed us three apartments near the station.
examples.zh: 我們的仲介帶我們看了車站附近的三間公寓。

examples.en: I called my insurance broker to ask about the new plan.
examples.zh: 我打電話給保險經紀人詢問新方案。

examples.en: The broker will call you when the stock price changes.
examples.zh: 股價有變動時，經紀人會打電話給你。

examples.en: The shipping broker arranged transport for all our goods.
examples.zh: 貨運仲介為我們所有的貨物安排了運輸。

confusable.diff: 只差一個字母，broke 是 break 的過去式，也可指「沒錢的」。
confusable.usage: broker 是名詞或動詞（仲介、居中促成），broke 是 break 的過去式或形容詞，不能互換。

example.en: Our printer broke down this morning, so we called a technician.
example.zh: 我們的印表機今天早上壞了，所以我們叫了技師。

similar.diff: agent 泛指代理人或代辦人；broker 多指金融、保險、房地產的買賣仲介。

example.en: A travel agent booked our flights and hotel rooms.
example.zh: 旅行社業務員幫我們訂了機票和飯店。

similar.diff: middleman 是口語說法，指買賣雙方之間的中間人，有時帶有多一層費用的意思。

example.en: We cut out the middleman and bought straight from the factory.
example.zh: 我們省掉中間商，直接向工廠購買。

example.en: Our sales agent will visit you on Monday.
example.zh: 我們的業務員星期一會去拜訪您。

example.en: The car dealer offered us a lower price.
example.zh: 汽車經銷商給了我們較低的價格。

example.en: The broker met a new client this afternoon.
example.zh: 經紀人今天下午見了一位新客戶。

derived.link: broker + -age，把仲介的工作或機構變成名詞，像 package、storage

example.en: The broker found a buyer for our old office building.
example.zh: 經紀人為我們的舊辦公大樓找到了買家。

example.en: The consultant offered to broker a new contract between us.
example.zh: 顧問提議居中促成我們之間的新合約。

extra_vocab.en: a part that makes a car or bike slow down or stop
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於汽車維修、交通安全與車輛廣告。也常用 put the brakes on 比喻「減緩、暫停」某件事。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 指煞車裝置常用複數 the brakes；當動詞時是不及物動詞，如 brake hard，後面不直接接受詞。

example.en: All the brakes on our delivery vans passed the safety test.
example.zh: 我們所有送貨車的煞車都通過了安全檢測。

example.en: She brakes early when the road is wet.
example.zh: 路面濕滑時，她會提早煞車。

example.en: The bus braked suddenly, and several passengers almost fell.
example.zh: 公車突然煞車，幾位乘客差點跌倒。

example.en: Hard braking can wear out your tires faster.
example.zh: 急煞車會讓輪胎磨損得更快。

example.en: Press the brake pedal slowly when you stop at the light.
example.zh: 在紅燈前停車時，請慢慢踩下煞車踏板。

example.en: He hit the brakes when the truck ahead stopped suddenly.
example.zh: 前面的卡車突然停下，他猛踩了煞車。

example.en: The board put the brakes on the plan to open a new branch.
example.zh: 董事會暫緩了開設新分店的計畫。

examples.en: The mechanic checked the brakes before returning the car to us.
examples.zh: 技師在把車還給我們之前檢查了煞車。

examples.en: The driver hit the brake when a child ran across the road.
examples.zh: 有小孩跑過馬路時，司機踩了煞車。

examples.en: This model has a new brake system for safer driving.
examples.zh: 這款車有新的煞車系統，讓駕駛更安全。

examples.en: Please order new brake pads for the delivery trucks.
examples.zh: 請為送貨卡車訂購新的煞車片。

confusable.diff: 發音完全相同，但 break 是「打破、中斷」或「休息」，brake 只指煞車。

example.en: Please take a short break before the next meeting starts.
example.zh: 請在下一場會議開始前稍微休息一下。

similar.diff: slow down 是一般的「減速」，不一定靠煞車；brake 強調用煞車減速或停下。

example.en: Please slow down when you drive through the parking lot.
example.zh: 開車經過停車場時請減速。

example.en: We need to change the front tire before the trip.
example.zh: 出發前我們需要更換前輪胎。

example.en: The engine of this truck is very quiet.
example.zh: 這輛卡車的引擎非常安靜。

example.en: Keep both hands on the wheel while you drive.
example.zh: 開車時請雙手握住方向盤。

example.en: The brake on this old bicycle needs to be fixed.
example.zh: 這輛舊腳踏車的煞車需要修理。

example.en: Drivers should brake gently when the road is wet.
example.zh: 路面濕滑時，駕駛人應該輕輕煞車。

senses.en: a part of a vehicle that is used to stop it

example.en: The technician replaced the brake before the final safety check.
example.zh: 技師在最後安全檢查前更換了煞車。

senses.en: something that slows down or limits growth
senses.distinguish: 從上下文看是 sales、growth、spending 等抽象名詞，就是「抑制」的意思，不是真的車輛零件。

example.en: The high price acted as a brake on sales growth.
example.zh: 高價格抑制了銷售成長。

extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於購物、作者簽書活動與促銷廣告。bookstore 是美式說法，英式常用 bookshop。

example.en: Many bookstores now sell coffee and small gifts as well.
example.zh: 現在許多書店也販售咖啡和小禮物。

example.en: You can order the textbook from an online bookstore tonight.
example.zh: 你今晚可以從網路書店訂購這本教科書。

example.en: Please support your local bookstore by joining the reading event.
example.zh: 請參加閱讀活動，支持你附近的書店。

example.en: The bookstore chain plans to open five new shops next year.
example.zh: 這家連鎖書店計畫明年新開五間分店。

examples.en: I bought a travel guide at the bookstore near my office.
examples.zh: 我在公司附近的書店買了一本旅遊指南。

examples.en: The author will sign copies at the bookstore on Saturday.
examples.zh: 作者星期六會在書店替讀者簽書。

examples.en: Our bookstore is having a sale on all business books.
examples.zh: 我們書店所有商業書籍都在特價。

examples.en: She works part-time at a bookstore on weekends to earn extra money.
examples.zh: 她週末在書店兼職賺外快。

confusable.diff: library 是圖書館，可免費借書；bookstore 是書店，要付錢買書。

example.en: You can borrow this book from the library for free.
example.zh: 你可以免費從圖書館借這本書。

similar.diff: 意思相同，bookshop 是英式說法，bookstore 是美式說法。

example.en: The bookshop on Main Street closes at eight tonight.
example.zh: 大街上的書店今晚八點關門。

example.en: The library opens at nine and closes at six.
example.zh: 圖書館九點開門，六點關門。

example.en: The publisher will send us fifty copies next week.
example.zh: 出版社下週會寄給我們五十本。

example.en: The author gave a short talk at the event.
example.zh: 作者在活動上做了一場簡短的演講。

extra_vocab.en: a large room where a company's directors meet
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於公司通知與會議安排，比一般會議室正式。也可指公司的最高決策層，如 boardroom decisions。

example.en: Both boardrooms are already reserved for the whole afternoon.
example.zh: 兩間董事會會議室整個下午都已被預約了。

example.en: The boardroom meeting will start at nine o'clock tomorrow.
example.zh: 董事會會議明天九點開始。

example.en: Mr. Chen is waiting for the investors in the boardroom.
example.zh: 陳先生正在董事會會議室等投資人。

example.en: Please book the boardroom for the training session next week.
example.zh: 請為下週的訓練課程預約董事會會議室。

examples.en: The meeting will be held in the boardroom on the fifth floor.
examples.zh: 會議將在五樓的董事會會議室舉行。

examples.en: Please do not leave any papers in the boardroom after use.
examples.zh: 使用後請不要在董事會會議室留下任何文件。

examples.en: Could you move the projector into the boardroom before nine?
examples.zh: 你能在九點前把投影機移到董事會會議室嗎？

examples.en: Changes in the boardroom may affect the company's future plans.
examples.zh: 高層的變動可能會影響公司的未來計畫。

similar.diff: conference room 是一般會議室；boardroom 較正式，通常供董事會或高層開會。

example.en: Let's use the conference room for the weekly team meeting.
example.zh: 我們用會議室開每週的團隊會議吧。

similar.diff: meeting room 是最普通的說法，任何大小的會議室都能用。

example.en: Meeting room B has a large screen for your presentation.
example.zh: B 會議室有大螢幕可供你簡報。

example.en: The board approved the new budget this morning.
example.zh: 董事會今天早上核准了新預算。

example.en: The director will talk about next year's goals.
example.zh: 主任會談明年的目標。

example.en: I will attend a sales conference in May.
example.zh: 我五月會參加一場業務研討會。

senses.en: a room where a company's directors hold meetings

example.en: The directors are waiting for you in the boardroom now.
example.zh: 董事們現在正在董事會會議室等你。

senses.en: the people who make the biggest decisions in a company
senses.distinguish: 後面接 decision、change、level 等字，指的是公司高層，不是真的房間。

example.en: Decisions made in the boardroom often affect thousands of workers.
example.zh: 高層做的決定常常影響數千名員工。

extra_vocab.en: the study of living things such as plants and animals
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於大學課程、研究計畫，以及藥廠或醫療公司的介紹與徵才。這個字通常用來說明學歷或專業背景。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: biology 是不可數名詞，不加 s；-ology 結尾的學科（geology、psychology）也一樣。

example.en: Many students study biology before they enter medical school.
example.zh: 許多學生在進入醫學院前會先學生物學。

example.en: He works on a marine biology project near the coast.
example.zh: 他在海邊參與一個海洋生物學的研究計畫。

example.en: Safety glasses are required in the biology lab at all times.
example.zh: 在生物實驗室內隨時都必須戴護目鏡。

examples.en: She studied biology at university before joining the research team.
examples.zh: 她加入研究團隊之前，在大學讀的是生物學。

examples.en: We are looking for a teacher with a degree in biology.
examples.zh: 我們正在尋找具有生物學學位的老師。

examples.en: The museum will hold a free biology workshop for children.
examples.zh: 博物館將為孩子舉辦免費的生物學工作坊。

examples.en: Our company uses biology research to develop new medicines.
examples.zh: 我們公司運用生物學研究來開發新藥。

confusable.diff: 拼法與發音相近，但 biography 是「傳記」，不是學科。

example.en: I read a biography of a famous businessman last month.
example.zh: 我上個月讀了一本知名商人的傳記。

example.en: The chemistry class starts at ten tomorrow morning.
example.zh: 化學課明天早上十點開始。

example.en: He teaches physics at a high school in Tainan.
example.zh: 他在台南的一所高中教物理。

example.en: The science fair will be held in the main hall.
example.zh: 科學展將在主廳舉行。

derived.link: biology + -ist，研究生物學的人，像 artist、scientist
biology + -ical，變成形容詞「生物學的」，像 logical、medical

extra_vocab.en: good for someone or something; helpful
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於合約、公司政策、培訓與廣告，語氣比 helpful 正式。最常用的說法是 beneficial to + 人或事物，以及 mutually beneficial。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: beneficial 後面常接 to + 人或事物（beneficial to employees），也可接 for；不要寫成 beneficial of。

example.en: We want a mutually beneficial partnership with every supplier.
example.zh: 我們希望與每家供應商建立互惠的合作關係。

example.en: Flexible hours are beneficial to workers with young children.
example.zh: 彈性工時對有幼兒的員工有好處。

example.en: The new policy had a beneficial effect on customer service.
example.zh: 新政策對客戶服務產生了有益的影響。

examples.en: We believe the new contract will be beneficial in the long run.
examples.zh: 我們相信新合約長期下來會有好處。

examples.en: The training course was very beneficial for new employees.
examples.zh: 這門訓練課程對新進員工非常有幫助。

examples.en: Regular exercise is beneficial, and our gym offers special prices.
examples.zh: 規律運動有益健康，我們的健身房提供優惠價格。

examples.en: Changing suppliers proved beneficial for our small company.
examples.zh: 更換供應商對我們這家小公司證明是有益的。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，但 beneficiary 是名詞，指保險或遺產的「受益人」。
confusable.usage: beneficial 是形容詞（有益的），beneficiary 是名詞（受益人），詞性不同不能互換。

example.en: The beneficiary of the insurance plan is her husband.
example.zh: 這份保險計畫的受益人是她的丈夫。

similar.diff: helpful 較口語，常指對人幫得上忙；beneficial 較正式，強調帶來好處。

example.en: Your advice was very helpful during the meeting.
example.zh: 你的建議在會議中非常有幫助。

similar.diff: useful 強調「有用、可使用」；beneficial 強調對整體或長期有好處。

example.en: This chart is useful for planning next year's budget.
example.zh: 這張圖表對規劃明年預算很有用。

example.en: Low prices give us an advantage over other stores.
example.zh: 低價讓我們比其他商店更有優勢。

example.en: The company made a large profit this quarter.
example.zh: 這間公司本季賺了很多利潤。

example.en: Your feedback is valuable to our team.
example.zh: 你的意見對我們團隊很有價值。

derived.link: benefit 是基礎字；beneficial 是 benefit 變成形容詞，意思是「帶來好處的」
beneficial + -ly，變成副詞「有益地」，像 quickly、carefully
